name: Agyrem
description: Spectral city of ghosts that overlays Ravnica, forming the Ghost Quarter.

description_citations.text: "The Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact does not recognize House Dimir, but the district of Agyrem reappears under the spirit Szadek's control.
timeline.quote: the district of Agyrem reappeared within Ravnica

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feather explains that Ravnica's seal folded over itself to create Agyrem, where the ghosts live.
timeline.quote: Like a blister on the skin, the seal folded over itself to create Agyrem , a mysterious place where the ghosts of Ravnica live.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 8". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: in Agyrem, the ghost of Szadek kills Razia and Feather flees.
timeline.quote: Then the ghost of Szadek appears and kills Razia.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 9". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact is created, the Schism fades and Agyrem overlays Ravnica; Kos becomes Boros commander there.
timeline.quote: Kos accepts the task of becoming the Boros commander for that area.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek manipulates the Guildpact into a paradox, causing its disintegration; the Parhelion crashes after its angels are slain in Agyrem.
timeline.quote: Szadek’s actions caused a paradox in the Guildpact, leading to its gradual disintegration.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agyrem overlays Ravnica as the Ghost Quarter and Agrus Kos returns as a ghost to lead its police force.
timeline.quote: The rise of Agyrem also marked the return of Agrus Kos , brought back as a ghost.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feather brings Kos's spirit back as a spirit officer for the Wojek in Agyrem.
timeline.quote: his spirit was brought back by Feather, who recruited him as a spirit officer for the Wojek

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zomaj Hauc accidentally creates the Schism while making a living space for ancient dragons.
timeline.quote: was accidentally created by Zomaj Hauc in 9965 Z.C.

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hauc betrays Niv-Mizzet and the hatchlings are killed by Teysa Karlov, Agrus Kos and friends.
timeline.quote: the hatchlings were killed by Teysa Karlov , Agrus Kos , and their friends

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Razia flies the Parhelion through the Schism to fight Szadek; Razia is killed with countless Boros angels.
timeline.quote: Razia was killed, along with countless Boros angels

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos apprehends Szadek, who is banished into Agyrem, laid over Ravnica as the Schism is healed.
timeline.quote: the vampire was banished into Agyrem

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Mending the ghost-world anomaly dissolves and the trapped spirits pass on.
timeline.quote: the trapped spirits were able to pass on to the aether

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The explosion tears open the Schism; every soul in Utvara is ripped from its body and the Schism snags Agyrem.
timeline.quote: every soul in Utvara was ripped from their bodies

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaluzax dies in the crash and awakens as a ghost in Agyrem.
timeline.quote: Kaluzax himself perished in the crash

citation.text: "Creation of the Schism", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emilya becomes a ghost in Agyrem.

citation.text: "Emilya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Over 126 years Emilya learns the Orzhov used her death to gather wealth, and becomes a Rusalka.
timeline.quote: Emilya discovered that the Orzhov used her death to manipulate and gather wealth

citation.text: "Emilya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szadek is revealed to have taken over Agyrem; Kos is appointed his warden.
timeline.quote: Kos, now a ghost himself, was appointed as his warden

citation.text: "Szadek", section "Death and reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Mending dissolves the ghost-world anomaly and the trapped spirits pass on.
timeline.quote: the trapped spirits were able to pass on to the aether

citation.text: "Szadek", section "Death and reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
